_comment: Copy to the PROJECT ROOT as attachments.json. One entry per place a part is fastened to another part. Consumed by check_attachment.py, wired into validate_scad.sh. Without this file the check reports SKIP -- every other check asks whether a part is CORRECT; none asks whether it has anything on it to attach WITH (INCIDENTS.md, 2026-09-11: side panels had no fastening at all and passed connectivity and dimensions).
name: panel_to_post_upper

_comment: Fields: name (label in the failure message), part (case-insensitive substring of the STL basename), at (the point IN ASSEMBLY COORDINATES where material must exist for the fastener), feature (what is supposed to be there, in words -- this is what makes a failure readable), min_material_mm (how much solid material the bore/thread needs around that point; a boss that is present but 1mm thick fails). Add one entry per fastening interface, not one per part. Delete these _comment entries and replace the examples.
name: base_to_frame_lower
